summary: Tested Iter 67 features: League Health Score backend (7 tests), Setup Wizard backend (4 tests), Push Notifications backend (8 tests), and frontend LeagueHealthCard + SetupWizard integration. Backend: all 19 pytest tests PASS. Chat @mention live test: POST /api/chat/channels/{id}/messages with '@admin hello! @nonexistent' returns 200, no backend errors logged, message persists. Mobile config: app.json contains expo.extra.eas.projectId placeholder UUID; MOBILE_DEPLOY.md exists. Frontend: LeagueHealthCard renders correctly at /commissioner/settings (NOT /commissioner — see note) with score ring (48/100), 6 weighted sections, past-seasons chips (2025/2024/2020/2019/2018), Season-Lifecycle banner, Renew form opens with year input + carry-over/reset toggles + 'Start 2027 season' button. ONE BUG FOUND: SetupWizard accent banner (testid wizard-prev-season-banner) is NEVER rendered — state set, never used in JSX.

ui_bugs.issue: Accent banner with data-testid='wizard-prev-season-banner' is missing. previousSeasonSuggestion state is fetched and stored (line 36/53), but never rendered as a JSX banner on the basics step. Spec requires: 'shows an accent banner (testid wizard-prev-season-banner) on the basics step' with text like 'Suggesting last year setup' + previous champion name.

integration_issues.issue: Review request states LeagueHealthCard renders on /commissioner page above Tabs, but it actually renders on /commissioner/settings (lovable CommissionerSettings.tsx). The /commissioner route uses CommissionerPage which does NOT include LeagueHealthCard. Either docs are wrong (testing succeeds at /commissioner/settings) or the card needs to be added to /commissioner page too.

action_items: Add the missing accent banner JSX to SetupWizard.jsx basics step (around line 220 inside wizard-body-basics div). Should use previousSeasonSuggestion state with data-testid='wizard-prev-season-banner' and display previous_season_year + champion + 'Suggesting last year setup' text.
Clarify whether LeagueHealthCard should also render on /commissioner (CommissionerPage) — currently only on /commissioner/settings. Update review docs OR add card to CommissionerPage.
critical_code_review_comments: SetupWizard.jsx: previousSeasonSuggestion useState is dead code on the JSX side — captured but never rendered. Add the banner per spec.
routes/seasons.py is clean (~360 LOC), well-structured, uses ObjectId properly, excludes _id when serializing. Section weights correctly sum to 100 (16+16+16+17+17+18=100).
chat.py @mention block (lines 295-345) wraps everything in try/except to be best-effort — good. Uses asyncio.create_task for non-blocking push send. Sender excluded from targets correctly.
complete-season endpoint is properly idempotent via update_one upsert=true.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (health card + renew flow work; SetupWizard banner missing)

seed_data_creation: Tests created snapshots for years 2018, 2019, 2020, 2024 in admin's primary league (Ice Kings Head-to-Head) — these persist across runs (idempotent on replay).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend solid. After main agent adds wizard-prev-season-banner JSX, retest by: (1) login admin, (2) goto /commissioner/settings, (3) close any auto-open wizard, (4) click 'Re-run Setup Wizard' button, (5) verify [data-testid='wizard-prev-season-banner'] is visible on basics step with previous champion text. Note: League's current_season_year is now 2026/2027 due to renew tests; future tests may need to bump to 2028+. The /commissioner/settings page auto-opens the SetupWizard when setup_wizard_complete=false (which renew-season sets). Past seasons in admin's league: 2018, 2019, 2020, 2024, 2025.
rca of the issue: SetupWizard.jsx fetches /setup-suggestions and stores in previousSeasonSuggestion state, prefills capCfg + schCfg from it (working), but never renders the accent banner UI. Fix: add a conditional <div data-testid='wizard-prev-season-banner'> in the wizard-body-basics block when previousSeasonSuggestion is non-null.
